digest.component_or_area: code-review gate dispatch and project criteria routing
propositions: Project code-review criteria with non-empty applies_to are never gated on changed files; they run on every review regardless of what changed.
The applies_to field is stored and retrievable but never validated at overlay load, permitting malformed values to silently revert to ungated behavior.
Project criteria bypass the workflow gate's membership filtering by appending after req.criteria, sidesteppingwhen expressions.
Unlike plan-review, code-review has no counterpart to project_trigger_fires or file_impact glob matching for project-supplied criteria.
applies_to validation and glob-matching against changed_files must be added to gate_dispatch and registry using the same _glob_match engine and changed_files list that triggers step uses.
An empty or absent applies_to for project criteria must remain always-on, preserving backward compatibility with existing project.review-phase-boundaries.
